description: Complete analysis of the research repository infrastructure, multi-agent workflow, and tooling pipeline for the fast DEFLATE decompression research project.

.archivara/.description: Core research infrastructure containing Python tooling scripts and agent configuration.

concept_evolve.py.purpose: ConceptEvolve CLI: concept-tree generation, probing, reframing, and walking via OpenCode sub-agents.
concept_evolve.py.mechanism: Launches opencode sub-agents via subprocess; sub-agents do research and write files; Python post-processes filesystem artifacts (builds adjacency graphs, walk paths, ensures concept folders).

semantic_scholar.py.purpose: Semantic Scholar API wrapper for literature graph mining.
features: Citation graph construction with configurable roots and fanout
BibTeX entry generation from paper IDs

opencode.json.purpose: OpenCode agent and tool configuration. Defines the multi-agent workflow.

agents_defined.writer: Paper writing and synthesis worker (has semantic_scholar, no concept_evolve)
agents_defined.reviewer: Peer review and quality control worker (has semantic_scholar, no concept_evolve)
agents_defined.concept_worker: ConceptEvolve sub-worker (no recursive concept tool, has full tool access)

.opencode/.description: OpenCode runtime configuration including custom agents and tool wrappers.

agents/concept-tree-explorer.md.purpose: Subagent for traversing concept trees, identifying missing links, proposing next experiments.

agents/literature-graph-miner.md.purpose: Subagent for mining citation graphs for transferable ideas and supporting evidence.

tools/concept_evolve.ts.purpose: TypeScript tool wrapper exposing concept_evolve commands to OpenCode agents.

tools/semantic_scholar.ts.purpose: TypeScript tool wrapper exposing semantic_scholar commands to OpenCode agents.

research_rubric.json.description: Central progress tracker with 5 phases and 28 items. Updated by agents to track research progress.

results/.description: Output directory for all research artifacts.

subdirs.concept_evolve/tree/: Individual concept folders with concept.json and README.md

figures/.description: Publication-grade figures in PNG (300 DPI) and PDF formats.

sources.bib.description: BibTeX bibliography (to be created). Minimum 15 entries required.

multi_agent_workflow.description: Sequential multi-agent pipeline: orchestrator -> researcher -> writer -> reviewer

stages.role: Creates research_rubric.json with phases and items. Planning only.
Executes all rubric items: literature search, implementation, benchmarking, analysis. Has full tool access including concept_evolve and semantic_scholar.
Drafts technical report and documentation. Uses semantic_scholar for citation validation.
Quality control: verifies acceptance criteria, checks statistical methodology, flags unsupported claims.

key_observations: The concept_evolve.py script uses file-based locking and caching (TTL 7200s) to avoid duplicate runs.
Sub-agents write files directly to disk; Python only does post-processing (graph construction, folder creation).
The concept_worker agent is specifically designed to prevent recursive concept_evolve invocations.
All agents share the same model (claude-opus-4-6) but have different tool access permissions.
The workflow is designed for incremental, artifact-driven research with concept folders as the unit of work.
